name: VNNews
description: Bản tin tiếng Việt — Vietnamese news bulletins read on air between 17:00 and 19:00 (Hanoi time), from VnExpress and friends.

settingsSchema.label: News from
settingsSchema.help: Local time in the zone below. 17:00 is the Vietnamese rush-hour slot.

settingsSchema.label: News until
settingsSchema.help: A window that wraps past midnight (22:00 → 02:00) works too.

settingsSchema.label: Time zone
settingsSchema.help: The window follows this zone, not the server's clock.

settingsSchema.label: A bulletin every
settingsSchema.help: Bulletins land on the grid from the start time: 17:00, 17:30, 18:00…

settingsSchema.label: Stories per bulletin
settingsSchema.help: Six takes about ninety seconds to read.

settingsSchema.label: Read the one-line summary
settingsSchema.help: Off gives a headlines-only bulletin, about a third as long.

settingsSchema.label: …or every N songs
settingsSchema.help: 0 is off. Set 5 and the headlines run between records as well as on the clock — whichever comes first.

settingsSchema.label: Song trigger ignores the window
settingsSchema.help: On, the every-N-songs bulletin runs around the clock. Off, it still only happens inside the news window.

settingsSchema.label: Music bed
settingsSchema.help: Music under the voice. A source query (ccsearch:… is Creative Commons and free), a URL, or a file. "none" for a dry bulletin.

settingsSchema.label: Bed level
settingsSchema.help: How loud the music sits before the ducker takes it down further.

settingsSchema.label: Duck under the voice
settingsSchema.help: How far the music drops while somebody is speaking.

settingsSchema.label: Language
settingsSchema.help: The voice used for the bulletin. The feeds decide the words; this decides the accent.

settingsSchema.label: Reading pace
settingsSchema.help: 1 is the voice's normal pace; 0.8 is a deliberate newsreader.

settingsSchema.label: RSS feeds
settingsSchema.help: In order of preference. Stories are interleaved across outlets so no single paper takes the bulletin.

settingsSchema.label: Ignore stories older than
settingsSchema.help: Stale stories are kept at the back for a quiet news day, never thrown away.

settingsSchema.label: Voice the bulletin in a worker thread
settingsSchema.help: Renders the speech off the event loop so the pacer never stutters. Falls back to inline rendering if the worker fails.

settingsSchema.label: Give up rendering after
settingsSchema.help: A bulletin that cannot be voiced in this time is abandoned, not queued forever.
